links.outcome: Reliability of registry reference labels used for model training and evaluation
links.effect: 54% (675/1260) of cohort 1 patients had missing or unknown registry metastasis labels; several model errors reflected incomplete registry labels, ambiguous language, or missing documentation.
links.quote: Error analysis indicated that several model errors reflected incomplete registry labels, ambiguous clinical language, or missing documentation.

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates LLM performance for extracting metastasis status from clinical notes across multiple cohorts, focusing on model accuracy/benchmarking without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
